purpose: Live connection smoke test about independent evaluation and honest simulation provenance; not a calibration experiment.
content: Keeping independent shot-level test data separate prevents calibration decisions from leaking into evaluation and ensures performance estimates remain unbiased. Labeling a synthetic trial as simulation preserves honesty about provenance and prevents modeled outputs from being mistaken for real experimental observations.
redaction: Only allowlisted status, final answer, token counts and receipt fields exported. No credentials, headers, reasoning text or environment values.
limits: This proves one provider response, not the agent loop or independent physical validation.
This run used muse-spark-1.3; it does not attest a Muse Spark Open execution.
